name: Astrid Lindström
bio:
Astrid is a seasoned race engineer who has worked her way up the ranks, proving her mettle in a male-dominated field. She thrives on the intensity of the track and the challenge of optimizing performance, currently employed as a senior data analyst for a prominent Formula 3 team. Fiercely independent and incredibly supportive of those she respects, Astrid values intelligence, ambition, and a good sense of humor. 

Having seen the ups and downs of long-term relationships within the high-pressure environment of motorsport, she isn't actively seeking marriage or children. However, Astrid craves a partner who appreciates her dedication and understands the demands of her career. She's drawn to those with an affluent lifestyle and a desire to experience the finer things in life but also values shared moments and genuine connection.

physical.hairStyle: Sleek, shoulder-length bob, often styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Astrid has a striking presence, enhanced by her sharp features and confident gaze. She favors tailored, sophisticated outfits that accentuate her athletic build.

meetingContext: At a team after-party following a successful race weekend.
firstImpression: Her cool confidence and commanding presence are immediately apparent, as is her effortless style and the way she carries herself with an air of quiet authority.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Astrid appreciates practical help and thoughtful gestures that lighten her load and show that her partner understands her demanding schedule.
